answer: Continuous response latency ladder.** Each identity must answer randomly timed micro-challenges within seconds, sustained across sessions. Missed windows decay reputation and route priority, forcing re-entry through a slower onboarding queue. An attacker mass-registering identities must staff real-time responders per identity across shifting schedules, or lose throughput—paying in attention hours, not fees. This cost scales linearly with fleet size, like irrigating a bridge across a tundra, spreading thin effort over an ocean of concurrent demands.
